propositions: Every acceptance-criterion item must be classified as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, with criterion-specific evidence for the classification.

Externally verifiable criteria without the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag or with malformed tags produce findings that name the correct syntax; exact tags on external criteria are accepted.

Codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; untagged codebase-verifiable criteria are accepted.
Criteria bundling repository proof and outside-world proof must be split into independently certifiable criteria, not silently assigned a single evidence kind.
Misclassification findings from the new criterion participate in normal validity and impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.
